Scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: (nothing flagged here)
Run 2: 别人：人们，this refers to the group of people already mentioned, not to “other people” contrasted with a speaker. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 3: 帮别人：帮人们，别人 distinguishes other people from a particular person already being discussed; this sentence means the general group of people who are becoming ill. [teacher rule: bieren]
